verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents a first-party managed connector framework in Computer that connects to 400+ services with one-click OAuth, so adding third-party connectors to the assistant is a documented capability. The evidence never describes a browsable directory or marketplace of apps, and the claim appears only in the Computer MCP server docs. missing for 10: a documented browsable connector/app directory in the consumer assistant, details on how users discover and add connectors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
